title: Full_Name_Syntax
description: Validates any full name that has between 0-3 first names and 1-3 last names.

First_Name.title: First_Name
First_Name.description: first_name = Name with the cardinality overwritten to 0-3 (for 0, this property is left out, as this property is not required)

21.T11969/Last_Name.title: Last_Name
21.T11969/Last_Name.description: last_name = Name with the cardinality overwritten to 1-3
